enabled.description: config `browser.signIns`. When false nothing of the browser was read and `profiles` is empty.

found.description: Chrome's user data folder exists on this Mac.

dir.description: The browser user's folder, such as `Default` or `Profile 7`.

name.description: The name Chrome shows; it may be an email.

signIns.description: Refs of the accounts this browser user signed in to on the vendor's website, as far as its local data shows; it may be left over from before a sign-out.

changedAt.description: When its Local Storage last changed (ISO 8601).

matched.description: Families whose accounts can be matched (claude, codex).

openOnly.description: Families that can only be opened in a browser user given with --profile (grok).
